question.text: If $a, c, b$ are in GP, then the area of the triangle formed by the lines $a x+b y+c=0$ with the coordinates axes is equal to

solution.text: Given $a, c, b$ are in GP $\Rightarrow \quad c^2=a b$...(i) According to question, $\begin{aligned} \therefore \text { Area of } \triangle O A B & =\left|\frac{1}{2} \times O A \times O B\right| \\ = & \left|\frac{1}{2} \times\left(\frac{-c}{b}\right) \times\left(\frac{-c}{a}\right)\right| \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{c^2}{a b}=\frac{1}{2} [by Eq. (i)] \end{aligned}$
